Episode 185. The Remaining People (2)
'Knight King' Ballas Runcandel.
He burst into a hearty laugh as soon as he saw Jin.
[Ha ha ha! I thought it would take another thousand years for such a person to appear in the family after my grandson. You've surprised me again. Like Chiron, that guy!]
At the phrase 'that guy', Jin's eyes widened unknowingly.
Because there was no one in this world who would dare to call Chiron that way.
But on second thought, there was no reason not to call a grandson beloved by his grandfather that way.
'Well, my great-grandfather would still remember my father as a boy.'
Ballas was a man who met his fate the year Chiron turned fifteen.
And while Jin didn't know much, Ballas and Chiron had a relationship similar to that of Ron and Dante.
There were not a few among the adults of the family who saw the period when Chiron began to become truly cold-hearted as the time after Ballas's death.
The other clansmen, already accustomed to Ballas's unrestrained speech, did not show any surprise.
However, Alphen seemed uncomfortable with Ballas casually addressing the current family head in such a public place, and whispered this in his ear.
'57th, wouldn't it be right to respect the current family head a little more in a place like this?'
But disregarding Alphen's effort, Ballas burst into another hearty laugh.
[Ha ha ha! Ancestor, it's okay! Chiron is not a man who would be offended by his grandfather, now that he's aged.]
'Now he's "a man", after calling him "that guy", 57th!'
[Ha ha ha, let's put aside the trivial things and welcome our great-grandson.]
Alphen touched his forehead, and Tasha smiled as if she found her father's behavior amusing.
She had noticed the contradiction in her father's old-fashioned view of 'propriety and law'.
As an ancestor, it was a problem that Ballas was too old to reprimand for his reckless speech.
Unlike Alphen and Tasha, who died young, Ballas had held the position as the family head into old age.
So, despite being an ancestor himself, Alphen had a hard time dealing with Ballas.
'Anyway, Dad has his cute side.'
Tasha was simply happy to be standing here with her father, whom she thought she would never see again.
"Nice to meet you for the first time, great-grandfather. I am the 12th flagbearer, Jin Runcandel."
[Oh yes!]
Jin waited for Ballas to say more, but there was silence for a while.
The gaze of Ballas, who was looking at him up and down with a grin, was somewhat burdensome.
'Well, 57th. All the clansmen are waiting. Wouldn't it be best to finish the appointment ceremony and return everyone to the frontlines quickly? It's a busy time.'
[Oh yes! That's right. I was so happy to see my great-grandson that I momentarily forgot. His body is sturdy, his eyes are good, and the aura he exudes is just glowing. Isn't it so, ancestor?]
'Yes, it is.'
[But ancestor, why have you been whispering from before? Is your throat sore? Should I prepare some medicine for you?]
Tasha's face turned almost red from trying to hold in her laughter, and Alphen let out a series of embarrassed coughs.
[...... Ahem! I'm fine.]

[It's much better to listen to clear words. Now, my great-grandson, come closer. We all hurriedly gathered like rookies when we heard you woke up. Do you know how fast this old man ran? The dust was about to fly from the fluttering of these empty sleeves. We need to process the appointment ceremony quickly!]
Ballas said, shaking the sleeve of his arm that pointed playfully outwards.
At that point, Jin, like Tasha, managed to hold back his laughter and approached him closer.
[You know the meaning of the coat you are wearing, right?]
"Yes, I do."
[I was supposed to bestow the black sword Kainer along with the coat, but I heard that some insect-like guy has it. By the way, we are currently tracking that bug and Kainer.]
"Did Joshua survive?"

[In fact, we don't know whether he fell behind or survived. The former is more likely. There were people who saw him bouncing around on the battlefield due to the shockwave. Ran and Vigo have been confirmed dead.]
Jin felt a bit squeamish about Joshua, and slightly bitter about Ran and Vigo.
Both were not important issues compared to the remaining people.
[Anyway, we've decided that you should lead the clan until Chiron comes back. The three of us should have enough authority, justification, and legitimacy.]

The 20th family head of the clan, who was called the knight of light and led the Holy Country's Defense War to victory 500 years ago, his daughter, the 21st family head, who cleared the remnants of the devil, and the 57th family head, who laid the foundation for modern Runcandel.
Without a doubt, the legitimacy held by the three of them was more than enough to appoint Jin as the Acting Head.
"Instead of me becoming the Acting Head, the three of you could take over as the Acting Head...."
[Ho! You're talking nonsense. What do you mean a phantom like us will act as the Head?]
At the word phantom, Jin swallowed a bitter sigh.
Of course, as comrades who had fought through the Malicious Shrine together, and as ancestors who were needed more than ever, Jin wished for their continued existence.
Their resurrection was achieved by adding the power of Chaos to the souls in the mausoleum.
Then when the Malicious Deity died, they should have disappeared too.
'If the three of you are still here because the power of the Malicious Deity hasn't completely disappeared, then the war isn't over yet......'
Just as Jin thought that far, Alphen shook his head as if he knew what Jin was thinking.

[12th Flagbearer. It has been confirmed several times by Hister's wizard that the power of the Malicious Deity has completely disappeared from this world. So, relax for now and kneel on one knee to the 57th.]
Jin kneeling on one knee and bowing his head.
Ballas looked down at his great-grandson with deep eyes, removing the playful look from his face.

[Alphen Runcandel, the 20th head of the Runcandel family, Tasha Runcandel, the 21st head, and I, Ballas Runcandel, the 57th head, want to grant a certain qualification to the brightest of the Flagbearers, following the long tradition and laws of the family.]
The knights all raised their swords at once.

[Jin Runcandel, the 12th Generation of the 59th Runcandel. After the family experienced the humiliation of the oath a thousand years ago, he protected the Garden of Swords from the greatest crisis and kept the name of Runcandel. Therefore, in place of the current head, we officially appoint the 12th Generation as the Acting Head of the family.]
Shing!
Ballas pulled out his sword and pressed it on Jin's shoulder.
Jin felt a pain as if his shoulder was going to break. Due to his body not being fully recovered, the pressure came more painfully.
The garden floor where Jin was kneeling began to sink as more and more powerful energy was infused into the sword pressing his shoulder.
[Let the 12th Flagbearer stand up, bearing the weight of the sword.]
Jin, who started to get up, shuddered his legs as if it was difficult.
About ten seconds later, when Jin completely got up, Ballas nodded satisfactorily.
'Heh, this guy is pretending to be hard, even helping to save this old man's face. He could have got up without any trouble.'
Ballas sheathed his sword.

[From this moment, you are the Acting Head of the family. Whenever there are major issues in the family without a head, anyone should look for you first, when there's good for the family, you should take it first, and when a crisis comes to the family, you should take all the responsibility.]
"I will bear it in mind."
[From now on, you are Runcandel, and Runcandel is you. Your words are the law of Runcandel, and your actions are the will of Runcandel. Turn around and look at your clan.]
When Jin turned his body,
All the clansmen knelt on one knee and placed their right hand on their chests. Even the brothers holding the flag bowed their heads and paid their respects.
The appointment of a clan chief without any dispute from all the past clan chiefs, as well as the entire clan, was unprecedented.
Jin felt an odd emotion rising within him.
He was now just one step away from the clan's throne that he had coveted since his previous life.
His heart was full, but his path seemed daunting. There had been too many farewells and sorrows on his way to this position, and the clan had been driven to the brink of extinction.
"......even more than my father."
Jin slowly looked down at his clansmen.
"I will outshine the past acting clan chiefs who were disgraceful. Even in the absence of the chief, I will make sure that you all do not feel his absence."
The clansmen were taken aback by his brimming confidence.
It was unimaginable for anyone, let alone the Rune Knight Rosa from his human life, to publicly declare that they would surpass Chiron.
However, the clansmen were feeling a familiar feeling after a long time.
They were all recalling the adolescent days of the 12th Rune Knight, who was always challenging and unconventional.
Looking back, Jin had always been like this.
He would take on tasks that no one else dared to take, and he never hesitated to fulfill the promises he made, no matter how much they were mocked.
The boy who shone back then had now become a giant carrying a deeper light.
"Ha! That lad's personality is quite refreshing! With this, we will conclude the appointment ceremony. Well then, deputy clan chief?"
Ballas gestured for him to issue commands to the clansmen quickly.

"Everyone, disperse quickly and return to the frontlines. Knights, come to the chief's office with the reports I need to check personally in 20 minutes. Also, the stewards and secretaries should compile detailed reports of the clan's assets and property holdings and submit them to me. From now on, we will rebuild the clan."
"We will obey!"
As soon as the order was issued, thousands of knights scattered orderly.
In the Sword Garden, the chief's command was so absolute.
In a blink of an eye, only Jin and the past clan chiefs remained in the garden.
After expressing his gratitude to them, Jin asked them a question.
"Ancestors, and Great Grandfather, may I ask why you three can still exist?"
At his words, Alphen responded with a faint smile.
"12th Rune Knight, we may seem to exist intact, but in reality, we are gradually disappearing."
